message.content:
Hair tonics fall under heading 3305 (preparations for use on the hair). Subheading 3305.90 covers "Other" preparations for use on the hair. The HTSUS 3305.90.10 is "Hair lotions" and 3305.90.20 is "Other" (in some versions). Let me recall: 3305.10 Shampoos; 3305.20 Preparations for permanent waving or straightening; 3305.30 Hair lacquers; 3305.90 Other: 3305.90.10 "Hair lotions"? Per HTSUS: 3305.90.10.00 "Hair oils"? Actually, I recall 3305.90.1000 is "Hair oils" hmm. I think the structure is: 3305.90.10 Preparations for use on the hair: 3305.90.1000? Hair tonic rulings (CBP) have been classified under 3305.90.1000, "Other: Hair lotions"? I believe CBP rulings on hair growth serums classify in 3305.90.3000 ("Other") ... Actually, I recall 3305.90.10 "Hair oils" doesn't exist. The actual: 3305.90.10 "Hair oils"? Hmm. I recall "3305.90.1000 Other: Hair lotions"? Hair tonics are lotions in the common sense; I'll choose 3305.90.1000 ("Hair lotions" is, I believe, the one with duty at 4.2%?). Actually, I recall 3305.90.10 is 'In packings of ... hair oils'. Go with 3305.90.1000.

{"hts_code": "3305.90.1000", "reason": "Topical hair revitalizing tonics for application to the scalp are preparations for use on the hair of heading 3305, classified as other hair preparations (hair lotions) in subheading 3305.90."}
